name: Levi
summary: Jacob's third son, born to Leah. With his brother Simeon he took violent revenge on the city of Shechem, and Jacob cursed their fierce anger.

key_moments.title: Born to Leah
key_moments.description: Leah bore Jacob a third son and said that now her husband would be joined to her, because she had borne him three sons. So he was named Levi.

key_moments.title: Kills the Men of Shechem
key_moments.description: After Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah, Simeon and Levi took their swords and killed the men of the city. Jacob told them they had brought trouble on him.

key_moments.title: Goes Down to Egypt
key_moments.description: Levi went down to Egypt with his father Jacob and the whole family, along with his sons.

key_moments.title: Rebuked in Jacob's Last Words
key_moments.description: Jacob said Simeon and Levi were brothers who used weapons of cruelty. He cursed their fierce anger and said they would be scattered in Israel.
